Instructions for *ACL Proceedings → Anonymity / Paper Length

requirements.title: Double-blind anonymization
requirements.requirement: As reviewing is double-blind, review versions must not include any identifying information about the authors (names, affiliations, URLs); self-references that reveal identity must be avoided and review versions must not include acknowledgements.

requirements.title: Long paper: eight content pages
requirements.requirement: Review versions of long papers may have up to eight (8) pages of content plus unlimited pages for references; all figures and tables that are part of the main text must fit within the limit.

requirements.title: A4 paper format
requirements.requirement: All papers must use A4 paper format (21 cm x 29.7 cm); papers must not be submitted with any other paper size.

requirements.title: All fonts embedded
requirements.requirement: The PDF file must embed all necessary fonts (especially for tree diagrams, symbols, and Asian languages); START will not let authors upload a final PDF without all fonts embedded.

requirements.title: Two-column layout
requirements.requirement: Manuscripts must be set in two columns; exceptions are the title, author block, and full-width figures or tables.
